**BLUF:**  
Ukrainian long-range strikes hit Russian oil infrastructure in Saratov and Volgograd regions overnight 10-11 Sep, with additional targets in the Black Sea and other Russian regions. Russia conducted mass drone attacks (including jet-powered Shaheds) on Kyiv gas stations and other sites, killing at least two and injuring dozens across multiple oblasts. Zelenskyy advanced a drone production deal with Canada; Belgium confirmed F-16 sustainment support. CISA added further exploited vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog. Middle East saw IDF strikes eliminating Hamas commanders and Israeli statements on Hezbollah/9/11; no major new escalations reported in standing priority regions.[[1]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-strikes-ukraine-with-missile-and-161-1789107354.html)[[2]](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-forces-kill-9-injure-145-across-ukraine-over-past-day-as-moscow-expands-gas-station-strikes-to-kyiv/)

## 1. GEOPOLITICAL AND MILITARY
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @ZelenskyyUa (11 Sep 2026 12:56 UTC) and @DefenceU (11 Sep 2026 13:07 UTC) reported Ukrainian long-range strikes hitting an enterprise and oil facility in Saratov/Volgograd regions, plus Black Sea and other Russian targets (Dagestan, Udmurtia, Tula, Nizhny Novgorod, Perm, Samara); DefenceU specifically confirmed Saratov oil refinery strike with fires recorded.[[3]](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2098395154218430586)[[4]](https://x.com/DefenceU/status/2098367336575127937)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @ZelenskyyUa (11 Sep 2026 12:03 UTC) and multiple web sources detailed Russian jet-powered Shahed/drone strikes targeting Kyiv gas stations (two killed, nine+ injured including double-tap on first responder) plus strikes across Kyiv, Kirovohrad, Dnipro, Odesa, Donetsk, Kherson, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv oblasts; additional residential building fire in Kyiv injuring eight.[[5]](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2098382031251976641)[[1]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-strikes-ukraine-with-missile-and-161-1789107354.html)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @ZelenskyyUa (11 Sep 2026 00:20 UTC) announced first Drone Deal with Canada (Alberta visit with PM Mark Carney); 30% of production to Ukraine.[[6]](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2098205032420155667)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @DefenceU (11 Sep 2026 07:36 UTC) highlighted Belgium €1B+ assistance including F-16 repairs, spares, and munitions against jet-powered drones.[[7]](https://x.com/DefenceU/status/2098314782889611302)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @DefenceU (11 Sep 2026 13:07 UTC) noted launch of EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance for battlefield expertise + industrial scale.[[8]](https://x.com/DefenceU/status/2098412880152420477)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @IDF (11 Sep 2026 08:09–13:15 UTC) reported elimination of Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Yazouri and Rafah Brigade sniper cell head Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda in Gaza.[[9]](https://x.com/IDF/status/2098383177077133403)[[10]](https://x.com/IDF/status/2098323073996918864)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] @IsraeliPM (11 Sep 2026 11:46 UTC) issued Shana Tova message highlighting U.S.-Israel progress against Iran axis and sanctions.[[11]](https://x.com/IsraeliPM/status/2098377741808591356)

**Assessment:** Reciprocal long-range strikes intensified with Ukraine targeting Russian energy/logistics and Russia focusing on Ukrainian civilian/economic sites (gas stations, residences); Canadian and Belgian support plus EU drone alliance advance Ukrainian production and sustainment capabilities. Middle East remained focused on Gaza/Hezbollah counterterrorism with no new major IRGC/proxy or Taiwan Strait developments in window.[[2]](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-forces-kill-9-injure-145-across-ukraine-over-past-day-as-moscow-expands-gas-station-strikes-to-kyiv/)

**Collection gaps:** No posts or reporting retrieved from @POTUS, @SecDef, @DeptofDefense, @CENTCOM, @INDOPACOM, @christogrozev, @RALee85, @Osinttechnical, or @Conflicts in window. Limited NATO output (primarily 9/11 remembrance and Baltic Sentry). No verified updates on Russian Black Sea Fleet or undersea infrastructure.

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
- [OSINT - WEB] CISA (10 Sep 2026) added MikroTik RouterOS vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-67277 missing authentication; CVE-2026-86060 command injection) to KEV catalog due to active exploitation.[[12]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/09/10/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)
- [OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets (11 Sep 2026) reported ongoing CISA KEV activity including Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (CVE-2026-20079 auth bypass), Citrix NetScaler (CVE-2026-19490), Fortinet, and others amid nation-state/ransomware exploitation of perimeter devices.[[13]](https://secureresearch.com/briefings/2026-09-11.html)

**Assessment:** Continued emphasis on patching edge/perimeter vulnerabilities exploited by threat actors; federal agencies face imminent remediation deadlines under BOD 26-04.

**Collection gaps:** No posts retrieved from @elonmusk, @sama, @satyanadella, @OpenAI, @xAI, @USCYBERCOM, @CISAgov, @FBI, @briankrebs, @SwiftOnSecurity, or @thegrugq in window. No new model releases or major breaches surfaced.

**GEOLOCATED EVENTS**
